discipline: One fresh CoW boot per arm; same immutable parent, 12GiB RAM/8vCPU, FullHD, production flags minus profiler, synthetic60Hz test broker/host GDM off for kayfabe,9216MiB store; VFIO physical display/full12282MiB. No product or guest driver setting changes. Restore after every boot. PCIe link preflight in host and guest, active windows decide downtraining.

G1.hypothesis: SM/memory clock, power-state or thermal/power capping differs and explains GPU cost
G1.falsifier: Both independent boots show SM clocks within5%, memory clocks within100MHz and equivalent active non-idle thermal/power throttle fractions within5 percentage points. No clock-setting changes permitted.

G2.hypothesis: Kayfabe has more PCIe/sysmem placement traffic or GPU memory activity
G2.falsifier: Both workload windows show PCIe RX/TX means within10% (or within100MB/s if near zero) and memory-controller busy within5 points; unavailable counters remain unverified, never filled with zero. Higher traffic alone does not prove harmful placement.

G3.falsifier: True no-present same-viewset arm preserves the gap; if unavailable, a matched D3D11 render-target proxy with identical work present vs no-present preserves the arm ratio within10%, qualified only to that proxy. No hidden/minimized window is called no-present. Generic draws are not claimed to replay closed workload commands.

G4.hypothesis: Reduced/segmented guest VRAM budget induces eviction/paging
G4.falsifier: Comparable guest budget/committed/local/nonlocal counters plus a supported eviction observer show no evictions and equivalent pressure in both arms. Memory-used alone cannot establish no eviction; an unsupported observer leaves the falsifier untested.

G5.falsifier: Physical engine-activity and guest3D/copy-engine distributions are equal across repeats under comparable load. Aggregate SM/mem/enc/dec data alone cannot prove equal TSG scheduling or preemption.

telemetry: 200ms physical GPU NVML and query-gpu clocks/power/temp/throttle/link/memory; Linux dmon1s; Windows physical VFIO NVML/query-gpu equivalent because dmon support must be checked. Minimal guest PDH/DXGI memory/engine data and supported eviction evidence. Collector support/status retained.
safety: Fastguest flock bounded120s, quiet flag around all VM/profile work; only own children; exact full Xid sequence snapshot and delta per arm, any new unmatched Xid stops lane; VF1 GPU+audio detach/restore; host final CUDA0/GDM/ubuntu/autologin/two monitors; owner VM remains stopped. Own HOST_YIELDED superseded only by explicit returned-host instruction.
publication: SPEC composites/subtests/ratios only via pinned spec_stamp.py with(nc)/release/config/disclaimer. Raw scores stay private until stamped. No Steel/Geekbench outputs.
initial_caveat: Equal global GPU busy does not isolate rendering from walker/display/copy work; K3 remains limited, not a proof that submission starvation is absent.

prelaunch_attempt.reason: Missing copied eligibility/CI receipt; controller raised before prepare/launch. Original failure retained. Final health CUDA0/GDM/NVIDIA; no held quiet flag. History initialization corrected for finally path.
